findings.title: Registry cannot be reached
findings.cause: image localhost/kube-diagnose-missing/web:dev names registry localhost, and on node kd-faults-control-plane that is the node itself, where no registry answers: the image was built on a workstation (podman and buildah name local builds localhost/...) or pushed to a registry there, and the node cannot reach either; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: Back-off pulling image "localhost/kube-diagnose-missing/web:dev": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image "localhost/kube-diagnose-missing/web:dev": failed to resolve reference "localhost/kube-diagnose-missing/web:dev": failed to do request: Head "https://localhost/v2/kube-diagnose-missing/web/manifests/dev": dial tcp [::1]:443: connect: connection refused

Failed to pull image "localhost/kube-diagnose-missing/web:dev": failed to pull and unpack image "localhost/kube-diagnose-missing/web:dev": failed to resolve reference "localhost/kube-diagnose-missing/web:dev": failed to do request: Head "https://localhost/v2/kube-diagnose-missing/web/manifests/dev": dial tcp [::1]:443: connect: connection refused

findings.fix: Push the image to a registry the nodes can reach and use that name, or load it onto the nodes (kind load docker-image, minikube image load) and set imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent so the kubelet does not pull it.
